data.one_liner: A draggable floating widget that can hide/show based on ScrollView events.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that can be dragged around the screen and positioned freely. It can automatically hide or show in response to scroll notifications via a StreamController.
use_when: You need a movable overlay element that follows user interaction
You want the widget to appear/disappear with scrolling
You prefer a lightweight solution without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need complex animations or physics beyond basic dragging
You require a fully featured UI kit or theming system
strengths: Simple API with configurable base config
weaknesses: Limited to basic drag behavior, no advanced gestures
Visibility control relies on manual StreamController handling
